bio.text: Zach Lahn, a farmer and business owner from Belle Plaine, Iowa, launched a campaign for governor as a Republican in November 2025, according to KCRG.
KCRG reported that he says he is a sixth-generation farmer and that he founded Homeplace Ventures, an Iowa-based company focused on agriculture, real estate and technology investments.
Ballotpedia lists him as the winner of the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for governor of Iowa.

sources.title: New candidate for Iowa governor: Zach Lahn launches campaign
